comments.body:

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As those who went before me taught: The JP wiki is your best resource, but not your only one. The same goes for your fellow players. Here's another option for when both may not work out.

If you click the "Japanese" at the top of this page and open it in a separate window/tab, you can see the JP version of this item. (Doesn't always work, but for most items in the DB it will.)

When possible, copy/paste the item's name into a search bar of choice and then go looking; sometimes with quote marks for an exact search, sometimes not. You'll usually find what you need. Cheers, and good voyaging/info hunting to you.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Strange, I tried it just now, and came up with:

特製シェリフコート (item name on JP page) --> plugged that name as it appeared right into Google (hate 'em, but...) --> top result: fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-451.html

Seems to be the Album reward coat you're looking for. Player blogs can be just as informative as wikis at times. More so, in some cases. I suppose I'm not telling you anything you don't already know; forgive my going over the basics as it's my habit to avoid missing any details. On the bright side, others new to the data hunt game who pass by here may learn this simple trick and be able to use it themselves.

Whether you find the coat's stats worth the effort is another matter. I'll leave that to you to figure out. Cheers!
